If you step onto the sandstone bedrock at Bhojpur, you are standing next to 11th-century architectural drawings carved into the quarry rocks that were never fully built.
Inside rests a colossal lingam standing over 7 feet tall.
Historians theorize that a mathematical error in calculating roof loads may have caused a collapse.
